publication: Prepared examples; check GitHub release and Pages for publication state.
scope: Complete rag, 152 unfolded bars: Intro AA BB A CC Bridge DD
musical_revision: Pickups and arrivals remain in the same melodic role, including alternative endings.
Both winds carry moving accompaniment and source C-theme inner voice, not only alternating rests.
Twenty selected double-stop locations; tied continuations receive the extra pitch from the original attack. Existing pitches, timing, velocity and source identity are preserved.
Bass and Chord retain their source-based groove. Chord labels appear at first sounding attack of that harmony; no N.C.

numbered_revision.accidentals_octave_dots: scaled with their own digit; same pitch reference as staff edition
numbered_revision.leading_eighth_rest: not joined by underline to following three eighth notes

native_window.method: Normal MuseScore Studio 4.7.5 windows and SVG export; 39 pages. First, middle/dense and last pages inspected; dynamics checked against text, notes, rests and accidentals. No CLI converter. Same-render thumbnails embedded.
